competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase Borrow is a meaningful source of cbXRP/USDC market demand.
support: Coinbase lists XRP collateral and Morpho loans.
Morpho cbXRP/USDC market has large displayed outstanding loans.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Morpho is permissionless with multiple vault suppliers and users; Coinbase-originated share is undisclosed.
competing_hypotheses.test: Compare Coinbase-originated loan IDs/contract events with total Morpho market positions using authorized product data or onchain attribution.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Morpho cbXRP liquidations can become native XRP sell pressure through Coinbase unwrapping.
support: Coinbase documents cbXRP unwrap path; Morpho can seize cbXRP.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Liquidator may hold cbXRP, transfer it, or sell elsewhere; no deposit/unwrap/sale chain verified.
competing_hypotheses.test: Trace each liquidator's cbXRP transfers, Coinbase deposit address, unwrap event and subsequent spot execution.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: High cbXRP borrowing reflects new XRP accumulation.
support: USDC borrowing is available against XRP collateral.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Borrowing can monetize existing XRP holdings; no spot purchase is required.
competing_hypotheses.test: Link collateral acquisition timestamps to exchange spot fills and wallet provenance.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Circle's native USDC deployment creates material XRPL dollar liquidity.
support: Circle supports native USDC on XRPL and Circle Mint/API.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Third-party supply snapshot is only about $4.47M; much smaller than RLUSD's reported XRPL supply.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile issuer account, trustlines, DEX depth, exchange balances and net mint/burn.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI is positioning XRP as its exclusive institutional settlement rail.
support: SBI has SBI Ripple Asia, XRPL PoCs and RLUSD distribution.
disconfirming_or_alternative: SBI also backs JPYSC/Startale, Circle Arc, USDC, BlackRock tokenized MMF exploration and Open Standard.
competing_hypotheses.test: Measure actual production flows and capital by rail rather than counting announcements.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Circle Arc and Coinbase are jointly positioned to compete with XRPL in institutional and agentic payments.
support: Arc uses USDC gas; SBI is validator; Coinbase is exchange-access partner; Circle reports USDC dominance in x402.
disconfirming_or_alternative: SBI simultaneously participates in XRPL; Circle USDC is native on XRPL; multi-rail coexistence is plausible.
competing_hypotheses.test: Track Arc vs XRPL settlement value, active counterparties, collateral, stablecoin balances and production contracts.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRPL x402 growth materially increases XRP demand.
support: T54 reports millions of payments and supports XRP settlement.
disconfirming_or_alternative: A September 8 snapshot had 4.49M tracked payments but only 5,836.71 XRP and 4,125.29 RLUSD settled; RLUSD can carry stable-value flow; fees are small.
competing_hypotheses.test: Measure net XRP bought/held, XRP-denominated settlement value, fee burn and unique paying wallets, not payment count.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRPL RWA headline value implies large immediately available collateral or liquidity.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Only $276M is reported distributed/transferable; $4.06B is registry value.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile token contracts, transfer restrictions, circulating supply, custody and active collateral markets.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Exchange-wallet outflows are bullish net spot accumulation.
support: Tracked wallet set fell 234.9M XRP over seven days.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Cold-storage movements, new addresses, wallet relabeling, OTC custody and internal rebalancing can create the same pattern.
competing_hypotheses.test: Address-level source/destination classification, exchange deposit/withdrawal tags, spot order-book fills and entity-level balance reconciliation.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Kamilah Stevenson channel is the creator the user calls Camilla Stephenson.
support: Public XRP podcast guest identifies YouTube as 'doctor Camilla Stevenson'; @drkamilahstevenson channel exists.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Name spelling differs; guest warns of fake pages; multiple impersonation pages exist.
competing_hypotheses.test: Verify the channel link from a self-controlled official social profile or video description before exhaustive inventory.
